$schema_note: Active evidence-based review rules for Python BI pipelines. Rules emit findings; they do not execute, auto-fix, or grant readiness.

rules.name: Merge cardinality not evidenced
rules.signal: A merge lacks declared input grains, key uniqueness, or expected cardinality.
rules.verdict_prompt: Does the merge-fanout checklist prove cardinality and reconcile row counts?

rules.name: Unresolved object dtype
rules.signal: A ready frame retains object dtype without a logical-type justification.
rules.verdict_prompt: Is every field bound to an explicit logical/storage type with rejection evidence?

rules.name: Python defines semantic time logic
rules.signal: Python invents fiscal, business-date, snapshot, or period-measure policy.
rules.verdict_prompt: Does Python only apply a governed calendar/metric contract?

rules.name: Reconciliation lacks independent controls
rules.signal: Expected and actual controls are derived through the same dataframe path.
rules.verdict_prompt: Is the expected boundary independent and scope-compatible?

rules.name: Python verdict bypasses readiness
rules.signal: A clean dataframe review is presented as readiness approval.
rules.verdict_prompt: Is the evidence packet handed to readiness without advancing a stage?
